correctness.rationale: Finite theorem with exact vertex/metric definition. The radius-one complex has 27 unique triangles and 81 edges; free-edge collapses leave a connected graph with cycle rank 28. At radius two the forbidden pairs form K3×K3×K3. A deterministic complete bitset enumeration constructs 5949 nonempty faces; 2951 staged element-toggle pairs leave exactly one critical 0-cell and 46 critical 3-cells. All 27189 Hasse cover relations are checked for directed cycles and a full topological sort visits all 5949 faces, proving an acyclic discrete-Morse matching. The resulting CW complex is a wedge of 46 3-spheres, not only a homology inference. Mod-two boundary ranks independently agree. Radius three is a full simplex. The barcode follows in all fields from the homotopy types and non-overlapping homology degrees.

value.rationale: The object is the smallest genuinely three-factor symmetric categorical product without a K2 factor, for which a published general homotopy conjecture remained beyond the proved family. Establishing the (3,3,3) case with an explicit complete acyclic matching resolves a natural concrete predicted but unproved fact; identifying it as the scale-two ternary Hamming Rips complex yields the entire persistence barcode. This is a motivated exact finite classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a claim about all parameter values.
